key.name: material
key.description: What the top bar, the dock, menus and notifications stand on: frost is thick, milky glass with an even tint; prism has less tint, more colour and light along its edges; clear is the thinnest glass, which darkens by itself where text needs it.

key.name: solid
key.description: Draw every glass surface in the theme's solid colours. Nothing is blurred, which also saves power.
